source: Adda247 CBE exam-screen export (candidate response-sheet PDF) of the actual SSC CHSL 2023 (2023-24) Tier I screen - header 'Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2023 Tier I', Exam Date 02/08/2023, bearing per-question SSC Question IDs and one candidate's Status/Chosen Option: https://www.adda247.com/jobs/wp-content/uploads/sites/22/2025/07/09181126/SSC-CHSL-2023-02-08-2023-Shift-I-Paper.pdf (accessed 2026-08-24; linked from Adda247's SSC CHSL PYQ page https://www.adda247.com/jobs/ssc-chsl-previous-year-question-paper/ which lists this date with Shifts 1-4).

corroborating_sources.name: Testbook - SSC CHSL 2023 Question Paper listing
corroborating_sources.note: Independently lists 'SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)' with 100 Questions / 200 Marks / 60 Mins, corroborating the existence of this date+shift and the CHSL Tier I pattern. (Testbook's actual paper PDFs are login-gated; not used as a question source.)

corroborating_sources.name: Drishti SSC (sscdrishti) - SSC CHSL Tier-I Question Paper English, 08-August-2023 Shift 1 (different date, same exam series)
corroborating_sources.note: Another genuine CBE response-sheet export of the same CHSL 2023 Tier I series (Exam Date 08/08/2023, Exam Time 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM = Shift 1). Used to corroborate the CBE screen conventions for this series: per-section numbering Q.1-Q.25 repeated in each section, SSC Question IDs of the form 264330xxxxxx, and the section order beginning with English Language. NOT used as a question-level source for this (different) date/shift.

notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (SSC Question IDs + one candidate's responses throughout), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment: the full English section (Q1-25) recovered, 4 Quant items fully recovered (Q51-52, Q57-partial-fragments, Q61-64), 3 Reasoning items fully recovered (Q35-37) + 2 partially, and 4 GA items fully recovered (Q90-93); the remaining items are image-only in the source and are marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] - they have NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I (per this export and the corroborating 08-Aug export): 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25). The CBE numbers questions 1-25 WITHIN each section; this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that section order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question. GA Q.23-25 (global 98-100) fall off the end of the source PDF's parsed text layer and could not be recovered at all. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENTS: several image-only Quant/GA questions leaked text into the PDF text layer out of sequence (e.g. '2x+2/x=5 ... (x^3+1/x^3+2)' with options 81/11, 81/7, 71/8, 81/8; 'If x+1/x=7, x^2+1/x^2'; 'If sin^2A+sin^4A=1, find (cos^2A+cos^4A)' with options 1, 3/2, 1/2; 'cos(theta)=9/17' with options 9/12, 208/289, 8/17, 81/289; a mixed-fraction option set 6 2/3, 5 2/3, 6 1/3, 4 1/3; a DI table Disciplines x Colleges A-D (Commerce 520/550/515/690, Management 212/234/289/390, Agriculture 234/567/456/876); a bar-chart label set 'Onions, Sugar, Rice, Wheat, 0 5 10 15 25'; a volume option '12034 cm^3'; a trig expression with options 2cot^2 theta, 2sec^2 theta, 2cos^2 theta, 2sin^2 theta; GA Q.10 option set 70 degrees / 60 degrees / '790' (sic, likely 79 degrees) / 40 degrees). These are listed here and NOT attached to specific question numbers because their attribution in the source layout cannot be established with certainty. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only (statuses Answered / Not Answered / Marked For Review included); they are NOT official answers. ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no accessible authoritative per-question answer source was available in this environment, so correct_answer is null for all questions per project answer policy.
